bio:
I'm an economics student at UMass Amherst who loves the moment a messy spreadsheet turns into a story someone can act on. I've done that for a research lab studying leadership in college sports, for polling clients in Washington, D.C., for a banking client in New York, and for nonprofits through 180 Degrees Consulting.

I grew up in India and studied at Welham Girls' School before coming to Amherst. Here, I founded our chapter of the United Nations Association, work as a Residential Assistant, and spend a lot of time thinking about how students can actually change the institutions around them.

Off the clock you'll find me dancing Kathak, playing intramural basketball, sketching, writing, or looking for the next trail.
programs: Commonwealth Honors College, iCons Integrated STEM Program
